The '''Snowdrift Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located in the [[Western Ice Shelf]] area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
During the events that followed the return of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' on Ilum during the [[Galactic War]], a huge [[k'lor'slug]] known as [[Surgok'k]] was studied in the cave by Gree [[Droid/Legends|droids]] until the beast was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="TOR:CS">{{TORcite|type=area|Combat Specimen|Ilum}}</ref>
